title: Solar Site Survey Customer Request Form
subtitle: An original solar site survey workflow that preserves the customer's observation and routes a clear service response, with explicit qualified-review, stop-work, escalation, and accountable handoff controls.
description: A workflow-complete solar site survey customer request form for the proposed photovoltaic site that captures exact identity, domain observations, supporting evidence, decisions, exceptions, responsible owners, and closeout without replacing professional judgment or the organization's controlling procedures.
use_case: Use when a customer asks for service, investigation, or follow-up and staff need a traceable account of the requested outcome, symptoms, evidence, safety screen, communication, and disposition. The survey coordinator owns routing, and closure requires documented evidence, disposition of restrictions, and acceptance by the designated reviewer.

sections.title: Solar site survey customer request and communication routing
sections.guidance: Capture the customer's own observation and give the request a clear service owner.

sections.title: Solar site survey requested outcome and customer constraints
sections.guidance: Describe the requested result without treating the customer's suspected cause as confirmed.

fields.label: Roof plane or ground area ID

blocks.label: Customer request type
items: Preliminary solar feasibility
Roof-mounted array concept
Ground-mounted array concept
Solar plus storage concept
Existing system expansion
Roof replacement coordination
Utility bill and load review
Proposal update after site change

blocks.label: Customer observation in their own words

fields.label: What was observed, when it began, frequency, affected service, desired outcome, and prior contact

sections.title: Solar site survey condition timeline and supplied evidence
sections.guidance: Preserve dates, sources, and attachments so service staff can distinguish symptoms from verified findings.

blocks.label: Customer-supplied evidence
items: Photograph or video reference
Bill, usage, or account reference
Display, alarm, or fault wording
Prior ticket or service record
Site plan, equipment document, or product reference
Access instruction, property permission, or appointment detail
Critical-service or accessibility information
No supporting attachment; follow-up owner assigned

sections.title: Solar site survey exceptions, stop conditions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make every unresolved condition visible with an immediate control, owner, due point, and final disposition.

blocks.label: Stop-condition screen
items: Unprotected roof edge, unstable ladder, or unsafe access
Wet, damaged, loose, or storm-affected roof or PV components
Exposed conductors, open electrical parts, arcing, or burn marks
Structural movement, severe deterioration, or falling-object exposure
High wind, lightning, ice, heat, or other unsafe weather
Unknown energized equipment or damaged wiring pathway
Blocked emergency access or uncontrolled public exposure
Any condition beyond the surveyor's authorization or training
blocks.guidance: Check any condition observed or reported; checking an item does not mean the condition is controlled.

blocks.label: Qualified-person and stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: This record does not authorize roof access, structural conclusions, or contact with electrical components. Stop the survey when access, weather, damaged components, exposed conductors, or structural conditions are unsafe. Keep unqualified people clear and route the condition to the site's qualified electrical, structural, or safety reviewer.

blocks.label: Exception and escalation register
blocks.guidance: Link each customer request exception to supporting evidence and keep it open until disposition is recorded.

sections.title: Solar site survey decision, handoff, and accountable closeout
sections.guidance: Record the decision, remaining limitations, next action, and the people accountable for acceptance.

blocks.label: Closeout completeness
items: Proposed photovoltaic site identity and location were reconciled
Observed facts, measurements, and evidence references are complete
Decision authority and applicable review requirements were confirmed
Stop conditions, restrictions, and open exceptions remain visible
Customer, operations, or site handoff was recorded
Next action, owner, due point, and record-retention route are explicit

fields.label: Limitations, assumptions, restrictions, customer message, and next-action context

blocks.label: Accountable review and handoff
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and handoff; they do not waive unresolved restrictions.
